scope: Ten selected public upstream projects; not an exhaustive survey of all open-source platforms. GitHub main/default branch refs were resolved to immutable commits before source/license reads.
source_pin_method: Authenticated GitHub repository, branch-ref and pinned file reads; documentation verified through primary sources.

license.classification: Apache-2.0 / prior MIT contributions; non-specification docs CC-BY-4.0 (transition; inspect applicable file/history)

projects.adoption: Retain the existing host-pinned SDK and transport; do not upgrade to main merely to add tools.
Optional Python MCP server dependency only if deployment actually runs Python; not required by existing TypeScript SwarmChat host.
Use checkpoint/store separation and per-effect replay boundaries as references; keep BEAST20 runtime without a redundant graph dependency.
Archived repository. Use bounded cancellation/message-contract references; do not adopt as a new runtime foundation.
Reference explicit plan/step progress and executor selection; do not import an LLM loop or infer remote agent access.
Actual source adaptation of automatic_tool_replay_allowed classification into tool_policy.py and tool-policy.mjs; preserve attribution and Apache license.
Reference only for MCP client/tool snapshot behavior; direct OpenAI API workers require separate authorized credential/access setup.
Optional later bulk report analytics; existing high-frequency task receipts stay SQLite. No claim of installation.

license.classification: Public domain for listed source directories; bundled/build files require individual review

projects.adoption: Existing actual storage runtime via Python sqlite3; preserve verified queries, transactions and source identity.
Reference for bounded per-key coordination; existing BEAST20 implementation remains independently written.

recommended_improvements.name: Focused native MCP operations
recommended_improvements.action: Expose separate component lookup, simulation run, run status and META145 result tools with stable identifiers.
recommended_improvements.validation: Initialize, tools/list, valid tools/call and unknown-name call through the actual host transport.

recommended_improvements.name: Exact structured contracts
recommended_improvements.action: Declare explicit inputSchema and outputSchema; validate model-visible structuredContent and bound summaries/pages.
recommended_improvements.validation: Reject invalid arguments; ensure schema-conformant success; return actionable isError tool failures without private data.

recommended_improvements.name: Authority from the host
recommended_improvements.action: Select tools/effect classes from immutable server registrations and authorize actual current context at dispatch and return.
recommended_improvements.validation: Unknown names, forged effect parameters, truthy nonboolean permissions and revoked returns must fail.

recommended_improvements.name: Effect-aware bounded retries
recommended_improvements.action: Use adapted Eigent read/keyed-write/reconciliation distinction with finite attempts and explicit timeout/unknown outcomes.
recommended_improvements.validation: Read retries and keyed idempotent writes eligible; ambiguous writes and child launches never auto-replay; one-attempt dispatcher does not self-retry.

recommended_improvements.name: Pin capability snapshots
recommended_improvements.action: Catalog each component by exact source/contract revision and readiness; record unavailable mounts instead of assuming package presence grants execution.
recommended_improvements.validation: Source digest/version changes invalidate references; unavailable adapters return a concrete status.

recommended_improvements.name: Separate execution checkpoint from knowledge memory
recommended_improvements.action: Keep run progress, successful task outputs and cross-run source evidence in their existing distinct scopes.
recommended_improvements.validation: Restart reuses committed tasks while source/principal/rights-epoch changes prevent cross-scope reuse.

recommended_improvements.name: Monotonic run-state receipts
recommended_improvements.action: Record blocked, failed, interrupted and completed states explicitly with immutable attempt IDs and a distinct result reference.
recommended_improvements.validation: A blocked module cannot become success solely because a summary says completed; transitions require matching task evidence.

recommended_improvements.name: Capability-limited discovery
recommended_improvements.action: Use focused list/search/get tools and bounded pages; preserve returned stable IDs rather than injecting every component into every model call.
recommended_improvements.validation: Pagination has no skipped/duplicate IDs; retrieval returns the requested pinned component only.

recommended_improvements.name: Cancellation with ambiguous-effect accounting
recommended_improvements.action: Bound active calls and keep unresolved timed-out calls counted until settlement; reconcile side effects before redispatch.
recommended_improvements.validation: Caller cancellation propagates; timed-out calls cannot create unbounded replacement work.

recommended_improvements.name: Protocol-correct errors and transport
recommended_improvements.action: Keep existing authenticated Streamable HTTP transport; distinguish malformed JSON-RPC from executed tool failures and check origin/auth server-side.
recommended_improvements.validation: Client accepts JSON and SSE as declared; malformed method/request yields protocol error; business/tool failure yields isError result.

recommended_improvements.name: Native component views with concise model data
recommended_improvements.action: Return summaries and stable evidence IDs in structuredContent; use optional MCP Apps UI resource links for larger interactive views.
recommended_improvements.validation: Model-visible results remain sufficient without UI; hidden _meta is not treated as a secure secret store or authority.

recommended_improvements.name: Workload-specific analytics selection
recommended_improvements.action: Retain SQLite for frequent transactional receipts; evaluate DuckDB only for larger scan/join/report workloads with measured before/after parity.
recommended_improvements.validation: Do not generalize bulk analytical performance to many small concurrent operations; retain unfavorable benchmark results.

limits: No upstream model API was called; no credential inspected or created.
Reviewing a source does not mean it is installed, mounted, licensed uniformly across all files, or performance-validated here.
The adapted replay policy does not implement remote idempotency; registered providers must enforce their promised semantics.
Python dispatch requires cooperative async handlers; JavaScript cannot preempt synchronous event-loop blocking code.
The Python registry queues admission within a deadline; the JavaScript mirror rejects full admission as NOT_EXECUTED.
Python receipts include implementation-local argument/result digests; JS mirror leaves cross-runtime digest production to the host.
